caption: The drawing features a single ornamental object centered vertically and horizontally on a plain, off-white background. The object appears to be a piece of jewelry, possibly a pendant or brooch, composed of a decorative central medallion with an ornate, symmetrical design in gold and brown tones. The medallion includes an oval centerpiece bordered by intricate patterns. Attached to the top of the medallion is a short section of chain with interlocking links in similar gold hues, and to the bottom are two long, straight tassels, each made of fine vertical lines representing chains or threads, also in shades of gold and yellow. The drawing is bordered by a thin, double-lined frame, and at the lower right corner outside the frame, there is small printed text reading “M. RINGL.”.
title: Brooch
